exposure: Knowledge of postpartum posttraumatic stress disorder (PP-PTSD)
outcome: Knowledge of risk factors, signs/symptoms, and consequences of FoC and PP-PTSD
Attitudes towards cesarean section on maternal request due to FoC
Strategies used during labor to reduce fear or likelihood of traumatic birth experience
Attitudes towards women with FoC or suspected PP-PTSD
cohort: 244 gynecologists and gynecology residents who were members of the Dutch Society of Obstetrics and Gynecology
finding: While gynecologists and residents demonstrated more knowledge about FoC than PP-PTSD, the study highlights a need for improved knowledge, particularly regarding PP-PTSD, to ensure appropriate recognition and management of both conditions.
